title: Ko heewi e majjuɓe
intro: Aɗa darii e yeeso ŋoral renndo ngo daartol mum winndaa e nder ŋoral. Ɗeeɗoo yontaaji nanii noddaango, cuɓii ƴattaade, njokkondiri e batte mbayliigu leydi. Hol ɓeen, hol ko wonti aduna maɓɓe?
clues: En nguurii gila ko ɓooyi, nulaaɗo arii e men gila e men.
Min ndewi sanamuuji joy, min calii woppude ɗi.
Min cemmbini nelaaɗo o, min tuumi mbo o majjuɗo.
Min ɗaɓɓi nde o addanta jukkungo ngoo so tawii ko o gooŋɗinɗo.
En njiyii asamaan ina ɓuuɓna toɓo, leydi ina ɓuuɓna ɓulli.
Min njahi haa dow nokkuuje toowɗe ngam doggugo, ammaa ndiyam ɗam janngi min.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Min mbaraa ko e ɓuuɓol mawngol
Min mberlaa e kaaƴe ummoraade e asamaan

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Enen fof eɗen halki so wonaa gooŋɗinɓe wonduɓe e Nuuhu
Min keddii ko no mborosaaji wonande yahooɓe
outcome.answer: Enen fof eɗen halki so wonaa gooŋɗinɓe wonduɓe e Nuuhu

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verse: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. (71:21)
